spec.description:
Kingspan Kooltherm K17 Insulated Plasterboard is a 3-in-1 internal wall
dry-lining system combining high-performance rigid thermoset phenolic
insulation, a moisture vapor control layer, and a 10mm tapered-edge gypsum
plasterboard face. Specifically engineered for adhesive dot-and-dab bonding or
mechanical fixing to concrete walls, masonry blockwork, and existing
plasterboard partitions, it delivers thermal conductivities as low as 0.021
W/m·K. It achieves 7-star energy ratings while reducing wall thickness by up
to 60% compared to traditional bulk insulation and stud assemblies.
features:
3-in-1 solution: thermal insulation, vapor control layer, and
interior plasterboard lining in one board

Ultra-thin wall profile increases
usable interior floor area by up to 60% compared to framed bulk batts
Exceptional thermal conductivity of 0.021 - 0.023 W/m·K (insulant core)

Suitable for direct adhesive bonding
(dot-and-dab) or mechanical fixing to masonry and concrete

10mm tapered edge
plasterboard face allows standard flush jointing and painting

Group 1-S /
Group 1 interior lining fire classification

Fiber-free closed-cell phenolic
core; resistant to moisture and water vapor

Manufactured in Australia with
zero ODP blowing agents

Global GreenTag GreenRate Level A certified with
verified EPD

technical.value:
35 mm, 40 mm, 50 mm, 60 mm, 70 mm, 80 mm, 90 mm (includes 10mm
plasterboard)

Vapor control layer incorporated between
insulant and plasterboard

install:
Inspect existing substrate
(concrete wall, brick, blockwork) ensuring it is dry, clean, sound, and free of
efflorescence

Cut boards approximately 15mm short of floor-to-ceiling height
using a plasterboard saw

For adhesive bonding, apply daubs (blobs) of
plasterboard masonry adhesive (25mm dia) at 300mm centers vertically and
horizontally

Alternatively apply continuous ribbon of adhesive around board
perimeter and service openings

Lift board into position using a foot-operated
board lifter resting on temporary wedges at floor level

Press board firmly
against the wall and tap flat with a long straight edge to align true and
plumb

Install a minimum of 2 mechanical safety anchors per board into
substrate once adhesive has set

Tape and finish tapered-edge joints using
standard plasterboard jointing compound and paper tape
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall substrate is masonry, concrete, or
internal framing suitable for drylining

Select required overall thickness
(e.g. 50mm for R1.80, 70mm for R2.70) to meet target energy rating

Verify
wall plumbness and tolerance for adhesive dab thickness (approx. 10-15mm)

Ensure mechanical safety fixings and plasterboard jointing accessories are
ordered
limitations:
Do not rely on adhesive bonding alone in overhead or ceiling applications
(mechanical fixing mandatory)

Do not use directly adjacent to combustion
sources or uninsulated fireplace flues

Substrate must be protected from
external water penetration before drylining

problem_keywords:
losing floor space to thick
wall framing
use_cases:
Direct adhesive dot-and-dab
drylining on concrete walls and masonry blockwork to eliminate timber stud
framing

Internal wall thermal retrofits in existing apartments and historic
solid-brick buildings where exterior alterations are prohibited

Slimline
internal wall lining to achieve 7-star NatHERS ratings while maximizing usable
floor space
not_for:
Overhead ceiling applications with adhesive only
(mechanical fixing required)
Direct contact with combustion sources or fireplace flues
retrieval.rag_summary:
Kingspan Kooltherm K17 Insulated Plasterboard is a 3-in-1 internal drylining
board combining rigid thermoset phenolic insulation (conductivity 0.021 W/m·K),
an integrated vapor barrier, and a 10mm tapered-edge plasterboard face. Sized
at 2400mm x 1200mm in overall thicknesses from 35mm to 90mm (R1.15 to R3.65), it
bonds directly to masonry, concrete, or framing via adhesive daubs to reduce
wall depth by up to 60% compared to stud systems. CodeMark certified and Group 1
fire classified under AS 5637.1, it delivers space-saving thermal comfort and
condensation control.
